zh: Markdown 表格可以拖动调整列宽。
平板筛选改成下拉，工具栏更紧凑；手机上的停止按钮留在卡片里。
侧栏里的子任务可以打开菜单。生成的标题跟随界面语言，生成时会闪一下，也可以撤销。
同一次会话里的子任务会标出来。
停止任务始终需要确认。
打开任务时先画出看得到的时间线。任务详情里的 Markdown 不再提供在窗口中打开。
拖动桌面侧栏和详情面板更顺，按住收起的泳道时不再跟着晃。
en: Markdown table columns can be dragged to a new width.
Tablet filters open as a dropdown and the toolbar is tighter. On a phone, Stop stays inside the card.
A subtask in the sidebar has its own menu. A generated title follows the interface language, shimmers while it is written, and can be undone.
A subtask from the same session is marked.
Stopping a task always asks for confirmation.
Opening a task draws the timeline that is on screen first. Markdown in task details no longer offers opening in a window.
Dragging the desktop sidebar and detail panels is smoother, and a collapsed lane stays still while it is pressed.
